family=nemotron_asr
variant=nemotron3_5_asr
model_root=/home/vlapy/llama-cpp-studio/data/models/audio-cpp/nemotron-3.5-asr-streaming-0.6b
description=NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 ASR streaming RNNT loaded from local assets.
  Supported tasks:
    --task asr --mode offline|streaming
  Available input options:
    --audio <wav>
    --batch-audio-dir <dir>
    --audio-chunk-seconds <float>
    --audio-chunk-mode auto|fixed|vad|none
  Model request options:
    language <string>  ASR prompt language such as en-US, da-DK, or auto; default is the model's default prompt.
    lookahead_tokens <int>  Chunk-limited encoder right context in 80 ms frames; supported values and the default come from processor_config (0, 3, 6 or 13; default 3 for the published model).
    max_tokens <int>  Maximum RNNT generated tokens; 0 or omitted uses the model-derived limit.
    keep_language_tags <bool>  Keep language tag tokens in decoded text; default false.
    return_timestamps <bool>  Return token timestamps; set by the CLI for --words-out. Token timestamps are always computed.
    streaming <bool>  Request a streaming run; must be false for offline sessions.
    speaker_probabilities <path>  nemotron_3_diar speaker_probabilities.safetensors for the same audio (diarize with return_frame_probabilities=true). Setting it enables speaker-tagged output: speaker turns with text and a SegLST artifact.
    speaker_mode <masked|attribution>  masked runs one ASR stream per active speaker on speaker-masked features (NeMo masked multitalker ASR) and transcribes overlapping speech; attribution assigns each word of one transcript to the most active speaker and is cheaper.
    speaker_mask <mel|audio>  Masked mode only: mask log-mel features (NeMo mask_features) or zero the waveform of inactive 80 ms frames.
    speaker_segment_gap_sec <float>  Start a new segment for a speaker after a pause longer than this; default 1.0 (NeMo sent_break_sec).
    speaker_segment_max_sec <float>  Streaming only: force-close a speaker-turn event after this many seconds; the final result keeps the full segments. Default 10.
  Model session options:
    nemotron_asr.weight_type <native|f32|f16|bf16|q8_0>  Shared matmul weight storage type; default native.
    nemotron_asr.matmul_weight_type <native|f32|f16|bf16|q8_0>  Encoder and decoder matmul weight storage type (native, f32, f16, bf16 or q8_0); defaults to weight_type.
    nemotron_asr.conv_weight_type <native|f32|f16>  Convolution weight storage type (native, f32 or f16); default native.
    nemotron_asr.weight_context_mb <int>  Weight context arena size in MiB; default 3072.
    nemotron_asr.encoder_graph_arena_mb <int>  Encoder graph arena size in MiB; default 1024.
    nemotron_asr.decoder_graph_arena_mb <int>  Decoder graph arena size in MiB; default 256.
    nemotron_asr.mem_saver <bool>  Release the offline encoder graph after each offline request; default false.
  Common output options:
    --out <file>
    --out-dir <dir>
    --text-out <txt>
    --segments-out <json>
    --vad-chunks-out <json>
    --vad-chunk-max-seconds <float>
    --vad-chunk-merge-gap-seconds <float>
    --vad-chunk-padding-seconds <float>
    --turns-out <json>
    --words-out <json>
